projects.title: Heal with a swipe
projects.description:
For this 360° campaign, with a strong emphasis on digital channels and lead generation, we crafted an experience that mirrored the essence of Dolohot’s flu medicine—healing with a simple swipe. At the heart of the campaign was an interactive webpage where users were invited to engage by "healing" with a swipe, echoing the product’s purpose. 

Each swipe brought them closer to a reward, as they were prompted to register for a gift redeemable at their local pharmacies. This seamless interaction not only captivated users but transformed a simple action into a meaningful connection, generating new…
